tabs.capability: Enumerate and address the exact active/background tabs that own media control sessions.
tabs.narrowing: The permission is app-wide because Popup, Background recovery and multi-tab control all address tabs before a per-feature grant could be requested.

alarms.capability: Own MV3-safe deadlines and recovery work across service-worker suspension.
alarms.narrowing: Alarm ownership is lifecycle infrastructure, not a user-invoked optional feature.

webNavigation.capability: Observe top-document navigation boundaries so runtime/document ownership cannot leak across navigations.
webNavigation.narrowing: Navigation identity is part of the safety fence for every supported media tab.

storage.capability: Persist and reconcile settings, route state and control authority across extension-context restarts.
storage.narrowing: Persistent product state is required before any optional feature-specific admission occurs.

downloads.capability: Save an explicitly requested screenshot through Chrome's download manager.
downloads.narrowing: The capability is user-invoked and should not remain an install-time grant if Chrome's optional-permission contract can preserve the same save semantics.

tabCapture.capability: Acquire a tab audio stream only when a processor path requires Capture.
tabCapture.narrowing: Capture is deliberately lazy and user-visible; permission admission should be capability-bound if Chrome permits an equivalent optional flow.

offscreen.capability: Host browser-owned audio Capture and remote transport work outside the MV3 service worker.
offscreen.narrowing: The offscreen document is a shared lifecycle owner for multiple admitted runtime capabilities; it is not itself an independently exposed user permission flow.

userScripts.capability: Register user-authored scripts only after the user configures the User Scripts feature.
userScripts.narrowing: User Scripts is not required for baseline media control and should be permission-admitted when the feature is enabled if platform semantics allow it.

scripting.capability: Inject and retire exact-document control/runtime surfaces after the minimal static bootstrap hands ownership to Background.
scripting.narrowing: Dynamic runtime acquisition is a core control path and is intentionally distinct from optional user-authored scripts.

favicon.capability: Render browser-provided tab favicons in the multi-tab Popup without fetching site icons directly.
favicon.narrowing: The Chrome favicon endpoint avoids independent network fetching and is used by the core tab-management surface.

<all_urls>.capability: Run the minimal media/bootstrap bridges on arbitrary user-selected web pages and address those exact documents later.
<all_urls>.narrowing: SPECTRA's product scope is media control on arbitrary sites; narrowing to a static domain allowlist would change that product contract. Runtime heavy work remains lease/lazy-gated after this broad host admission.
